ev.q: is an American science fiction adventure drama television series
It contains elements of supernatural fiction
augmented by flashback or flashforward sequences
the show is told in a heavily serialized manner
similar use of nonlinear narrative and mysteries
Due to its large ensemble cast
aired on ABC from September 22, 2004, to May 23, 2010
with a total of 121 episodes over six seasons
received a strongly polarized reaction from both fans and TV critics alike
